_comment: Open incidents that own a red scheduled or post-deploy monitor (docs/ON_CALL_PROCESS.md, Red monitors need an owner). One JSON object per line after this header: {repo?, workflow (file name, as in the registry receipt), incident (Linear key or URL), owner, openedAt, until, reason}. The lease is live until `until`, never longer than 7 days from openedAt (jovie-hold/v1 cap); renew it with a new line or retire the monitor. scripts/lib/red-monitor-owner-gate.mjs reads it from scripts/automation-liveness.mjs.
